name: Musical Chairs 🎵🪑
desc:
🎵 Welcome to Musical Chairs! 🪑
Don't be the last one to find a seat!

How to play:
- Run around the chairs and find one when the music stops! If you don't, you're out!
- The last person alive wins!

🪙 Earn coins to buy pets, trails, and chair skins!

Premium users get extra coins every win!

LIKE AND FAVORITE FOR NEW UPDATES AND FEATURES! 👍⭐
